faqs.a: It could be - sudden toothaches, injuries, and other serious problems are exactly what our emergency care is for. Our dentists are always on call, even on the weekend, and will come in for emergency cases. Call (281) 336-9899 right away.

faqs.a: Yes - we use CEREC technology to make durable, natural-looking crowns the same day, in just a single visit, instead of weeks and multiple appointments.
faqs.q: Can I get a crown in a single visit?

faqs.a: Yes - we offer several sedation options, including nitrous oxide, oral conscious sedation, and IV sedation, for patients with dental anxiety, a sensitive gag reflex, or trouble sitting still.
faqs.q: Do you have sedation for nervous patients?

faqs.a: Yes - Invisalign straightens your smile with clear, removable aligners and no restrictions on diet or your daily dental care routine. Aligners should be worn at least 20 to 22 hours a day, and our dentists can tell you if you're a candidate.
We have five locations across Fort Bend County: Missouri City, Rosenberg, Grand Parkway (Richmond), Aliana, and Sugar Land - serving families across Southeast Texas.
Please give our office 48 hours notice before cancellations or changes - otherwise a $75 cancellation fee applies.
Fort Bend Dental has been providing exceptional dental care to families across Southeast Texas since 1987.
